title: At the optician's
instructions: Lucy gözlükçüde göz muayenesi oluyor. Sorunu, sonucu ve seçimini takip et.

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: I can't see the board well at university, and I often get headaches.

script.speaker: optician
script.text: OK, let's test your eyes. Can you read the letters on the wall?

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: The big ones, yes. The small ones at the bottom, no.

script.speaker: optician
script.text: You need glasses for distance. You don't need them for reading.

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: Do I have to wear them all the time?

script.speaker: optician
script.text: No, only in class, for driving and for watching TV.

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: OK. I like these black frames.

script.speaker: optician
script.text: Good choice. They'll be ready on Thursday.

options: She can't see the board well.
Her eyes hurt in the sun.
questions.feedback: Üniversitede tahtayı iyi göremiyor ve sık sık başı ağrıyor.
questions.evidence: I can't see the board well at university

questions.prompt: What can't Lucy read on the wall?
options: the small letters at the bottom
questions.feedback: Büyük harfleri okuyabiliyor; alttaki küçük harfleri okuyamıyor.
questions.evidence: The small ones at the bottom, no.

questions.prompt: When does Lucy need to wear glasses?
options: in class, for driving and watching TV
questions.feedback: Sadece derste, araba sürerken ve televizyon izlerken.
questions.evidence: only in class, for driving and for watching TV.

questions.prompt: When will the glasses be ready?
